title: One line of log.jsonl — who, when, what, why (design §4.3, §4.2)
description: Append only, one JSON object per line, engine-local, not committed. `who` is engine | leader | human | sprint | role:<name>. Why = trigger (change-reason code) or reason (leader-decision code) or code (failure / stop code) + note (free text; the engine never branches on note, §4.1). U19 `collect.py --log` reads: event=stop (status needs_human/needs_leader, code=<stop reason>), event=pr-created, event=answer (reason, data.answer), event=attempt-end (data.cost_usd; data.flaky = true only when a safety-net-proof run was not green, then green on the same overlay tree and passed — VW4 O1). Stage 2: event=leader-call (data: situation, kind check|leader, k, phase start|end, answer, cost_usd, failed, format_retry), event=answer with who=leader (reason, data.answer, data.step, data.situation; new comment: data.effects), event=issue-closed (data.reason completed|not-planned, data.comment_id). Stage 3: event=procedure-written (data.source = codes.ProcedureSource, data.revision, data.candidate; role-request: data.requests [{from_step, step, outcome, reason}]), event=request (data: op, step, outcome, reason — codes.RequestOutcome / RequestReason; trigger), event=followup-created / followup-commented (data: key, kind, number (null in a dry run), dry_run), event=security-private-path (data.count), event=irreversible-detected (data: category, level, default_level, lowered, source, code | path), event=model-raised (data = the session.escalation object), event=pr-updated (data: number, head), event=canary (K8-1 — a paid role canary the engine ran itself: data.key, role_class, cli_version, ok, cost_usd — NOT part of the Issue cost (no facts.json), sessions, evidence folder name), event=answer (data.dismiss = review step, who=human; data.skip_step; data.defer; data.session). Stage 4: event=sprint-member (data: tracker, base_sha, base_branch, draft — the start input), event=answer with who=sprint (the automatic rerun of a quota stop, H8; data.answer = rerun), event=test-change-allowed (who=human; data.paths, data.note_sha256), event=mutation-proof (data: head, problem, counts {<MutationStatus>: n}, record — the record file name, reruns — what ran a second time: `control` (red, K8-2) and the mutation ids (red after a flaky control), control_flaky; who=human with superseded: true — a human rerun moved a record without any run fact aside, record = its new name superseded-<n>.json, counts = its rows).

data.description: Free structured payload of the event (e.g. request, back_to target, sha, url, traceback).
